articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin sinks below $83,000 as Iran talks stall and oil climbs

articles.title: How months of work on the Clarity Act all fell apart
articles.snippet: Interviews with industry participants and legislative aides paint a picture of a blown bill-writing process, with sources pointing to nearly every facet of the bill's development and the debate around it as contributing factors to this month's failed vote.

articles.title: Kraken’s parent Payward is betting billions on becoming financial infrastructure, not just a crypto exchange
articles.snippet: Kraken parent Payward is unifying trading, payments, asset management and institutional services on common rails, co-CEO Arjun Sethi said.

articles.title: Altcoins rally across the board as bitcoin consolidates near $84,000
articles.snippet: Quant jumped 39% over 24 hours and 93 of 100 CoinDesk 100 constituents rose, with the altcoin season index at its highest in more than three months.
